title: From Robot Play to AI Literacy at RoboCup 2026
summary: Park's Incheon update introduced a planned presentation on helping older adults understand, question, and control AI.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: During RoboCup 2026 in Incheon, Chorong Park shared a July 5 update connecting robot play with AI literacy. She announced a WEROB presentation, "From Robot Play to AI Literacy," scheduled for the following day.

The proposed focus was on how companion robots could help older adults make sense of AI in everyday life. Understanding a system, questioning its behavior, and retaining control were central to the approach she described.

Park framed educational robotics as a community-centered activity, bringing together accessibility, trust, privacy awareness, and enjoyable learning. The post presents a research direction, not evidence that a particular robot has already improved AI literacy.

Her eight photographs document the broader RoboCup setting, from robot demonstrations and competition spaces to the gathering of participants. They offer a visual record of the event alongside the planned research contribution.
